jobs.title: Group Product Manager – Product Growth
jobs.location: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
jobs.description:
About Unframe

Unframe is an AI-first startup helping the world’s largest enterprises bring LLM-powered applications to life in days - not months. We combine the speed of a product company with the flexibility of a consultancy, helping customers move from idea to deployed AI systems faster than anyone else in the market.

Backed by Bessemer, Craft, and TLV Partners with $100M in Series B funding, we’re building a fast-growing, revenue-generating company working with Fortune 500 customers globally

About the role

We’re looking for a Group Product Manager (GPM) to lead a team of Product Managers and own a portfolio of enterprise AI solutions in production.

This is a highly ambiguous, fast-paced environment where many problems are not predefined . You will be expected to deeply understand customer needs, identify the right problems to solve, and lead your team in building solutions that deliver meaningful business value.

You will operate as a product leader with end-to-end ownership, shaping opportunities, driving execution, and scaling successful solutions.

What you’ll do

- Lead a team of Product Managers working on complex, high-impact AI solutions in production

- Work closely with customers and internal teams to identify high-value problems and define what to build

- Operate in high ambiguity, shaping opportunities where requirements are not clearly defined

- Drive the development of new solutions from early stages to production, making key product and trade-off decisions

- Own a portfolio of solutions across one or more enterprise customers, setting priorities across multiple parallel initiatives

- Balance speed of execution with long-term scalability, quality, and product thinking

- Identify patterns across solutions and push for reuse and productization

- Mentor and develop Product Managers, helping them operate effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment

What we’re looking for

- 7+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years leading Product Managers, in high-growth or complex environments

- Experience managing strong PMs, setting direction while empowering ownership and independent decision-making

- Ability to operate in ambiguity, define problems, and lead teams in building new solutions from early stages to production

- Proven track record of driving products or systems from concept to real-world impact, balancing speed, quality, and scalability

- Experience working on complex systems and with enterprise customers, navigating competing needs and constraints

- Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills, working closely with engineering, AI, GTM, and customers

Why this role is unique

This isn’t a typical product role. You won’t inherit a roadmap, you’ll help define what’s worth building, working on real problems with real enterprise customers. You’ll operate in a true 0→1 environment at scale, taking ideas all the way to production. From day one, you’ll have real ownership, shaping direction, making decisions, and leading a team through ambiguity. You’ll work closely with founders and senior leaders in a fast-moving company where things actually get built.

- Mentor and develop your PMs, growing their product judgment and helping them operate effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment

Then you take it from first idea to a deployed solution. You'll work in a true 0→1 environment, shipping AI products to Fortune 500 customers in days, not months. From day one you'll have real ownership: shaping direction, making the product calls, and leading a team through ambiguity. You'll work closely with founders and senior leaders in a fast-moving company where things actually get built.

As an AI Product Manager on our team, you’ll work directly with customers and internal teams to define, scope, and deliver AI-powered solutions using Unframe’s platform. You’ll bridge product thinking with real-world use cases, enabling fast, reliable delivery of custom solutions built on a shared core. This is an opportunity to work with top-tier global customers and solve real, high-impact problems.

What you’ll do

- Translate customer problems into structured solution plans using Unframe.ai’s platform

- Own the delivery of end-to-end projects in collaboration with engineers and AI specialists.

- Write detailed specs and define prompt/context structures for solution logic.

- 4+ years of experience in product management or technical delivery roles.

- Experience working closely with engineering teams and technical products.

- Ability to manage complex projects with multiple moving parts.

- Strong written communication, systems thinking, and attention to detail.

- Fluent English speaker - written and verbal communication must be excellent.

- Comfortable working in fast-paced environments with evolving requirements.

At Unframe, you’ll work on real AI products used by real customers, not experiments or demos. This role offers a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of customer problems, product strategy, and AI execution, with true ownership over solutions from idea to delivery. You’ll collaborate with strong engineers and AI specialists, influence how our platform evolves, and help shape reusable product capabilities as we scale. If you’re motivated by impact, complexity, and building practical AI systems that actually ship, you’ll find this role both challenging and rewarding.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
About Unframe

Unframe is an AI-first startup helping the world’s largest enterprises bring LLM-powered applications to life in days - not months. We combine the speed of a product company with the flexibility of a consultancy, helping customers move from idea to deployed AI systems faster than anyone else in the market.

Backed by Bessemer, Craft, and TLV Partners with $100M in Series B funding, we’re building a fast-growing, revenue-generating company working with Fortune 500 customers globally

About the role

This role sits on the front line: you engage directly with enterprise clients, lead discovery to uncover core business challenges, and design and ship tailored AI solutions built on Unframe's platform. You own the work end-to-end, serving as the strategic and technical bridge from initial conversation through to final deployment.

This is a true builder role. You write the precise specifications and prompt architectures that bring solutions to life, making the critical design decisions that determine whether an enterprise AI deployment actually succeeds.

What you’ll do

This is a project-led role with unmediated access to clients at every stage. You will typically manage several engagements simultaneously, with short planning horizons and evolving requirements. Roughly 30 to 40 percent of the role is active client management, ensuring senior stakeholders remain aligned through delivery, progress reviews, and post-deployment rollouts.

-

- Lead Enterprise Discovery: Conduct discovery sessions directly with enterprise clients to map workflows, uncover business challenges, and distinguish surface-level requests from fundamental operational needs.

- Design & Spec AI Solutions: Translate customer problems into structured solution plans on Unframe's platform. Write detailed specs and define prompt and context structures, owning the complete solution design.

- Drive End-to-End Delivery: Collaborate with engineers and AI specialists to deliver solutions on target. Prioritize requirements and manage tradeoffs across speed, stability, and scope.

- Represent the User & Platform: Act as the voice of enterprise operators and domain experts while collaborating with the Platform team to identify reusable product patterns.

What we’re looking for

- 4+ years of experience in product management or technical delivery roles, with a proven track record working alongside engineering teams on complex, fast-paced technical products.

- Customer-Led Discovery: Proven experience personally leading consultative conversations with enterprise buyers and operators - not supporting a sales call, not interviewing platform users, but owning the conversation to surface unstated needs and translate them into clear solution scope.

- Enterprise Stakeholder Management: Ability to manage senior client relationships through a complex delivery; keeping stakeholders aligned, navigating competing priorities, and being the primary point of contact when requirements shift or timelines compress.

- Problem-to-Solution Design: Ability to start from a raw business problem without existing features for reference, defining exactly how an AI solution should function and writing precise specs for build teams.

- Complex Delivery Execution: Experience shipping AI-powered features under tight timelines, managing evolving requirements, and documenting strategic tradeoffs.

- AI Solutions Experience: Direct exposure to building with LLMs - writing prompt structures, defining context and output constraints, working with agentic systems, or managing model uncertainty in a shipped product or working prototype. This is the dimension most learnable on the job; concrete work product carries more weight than certification.

- Builder Orientation: Driven by creating customer-facing solutions rather than simply managing traditional roadmaps or processing requests.

- Core Competencies: Strong written communication, systems thinking, high attention to detail, fluent English (written and verbal), and the ability to navigate multi-faceted projects.

Location

Based in the United States; East Coast or New York preferred for shared office time, though we will consider strong candidates across the US. US work authorization required.

Why join us

At Unframe, you’ll help build AI systems that are already delivering real value to global enterprises - not prototypes, demos, or side projects.

You’ll work with exceptional teammates, collaborate directly with top-tier customers, and have real influence over both the solutions we ship and the evolution of our platform. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where product thinking, technical depth, and creativity come together.

If you enjoy solving hard problems, moving fast, and building practical AI products that actually make it to production - we’d love to meet you.
